title: How many atoms belong to the molecule that element is hydrogen and labeled
question: How many atoms belong to the molecule that element is hydrogen and labeled with carcinogenic compound?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM AtomDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN AtomMolecule AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'h'
  AND T3.label = '+'
